analysis.title: Take-Two Interactive Software Inc. (TTWO) FQ2'27 Earnings Review: FY27 Bookings Outlook Reiterated; Focus Remains Squarely on GTA VI Launch
key_insights: FQ2'27 net bookings of $1,601mm came in below the company's $1,620-1,670mm outlook and below GS ($1,654mm) and consensus ($1,702mm). NBA 2K27 had the second strongest launch in franchise history but missed internal expectations.

Management reiterated the FY27 net bookings outlook. GTA VI pre-orders are tracking well above initial expectations ahead of the November 19 release. Management is waiting for post-launch data before including any upside.

Recurrent Consumer Spend (RCS) declined 9% YoY in the quarter against management's expectation of a 5% decline, on weakness in NBA 2K and Mobile, including a double-digit decline in Color Block Jam against a strong FQ2'26.

Mobile bookings were in line with management expectations. Toon Blast and Words With Friends grew, advertising improved sequentially, and the D2C channel kept growing with a meaningful margin benefit.

FY27 GAAP revenue guidance rose modestly and operating expense guidance fell (+5% YoY) on lower user-acquisition costs, partly from timing of new mobile releases. Growth is driven by R&D and GTA VI marketing.
GS sees the unchanged full-year outlook as implying confidence in GTA VI demand and an NBA 2K improvement in 2H27, supported by the largest planned post-launch content slate.

GS expects investor debate to center on GTA VI launch-unit performance and Ultimate Edition mix, post-launch engagement across the GTA ecosystem, the 2H acceleration in NBA 2K bookings, and mobile stabilization as Color Block Jam comps normalize.
GS reiterates Buy and raises its 12-month price target to $290 from $285, which is 39.8% above the $207.40 price.
GS FY27 estimate changes: bookings $8.20bn (unchanged), adj. EBIT $1.41bn (from $1.56bn), adj. EPS $6.00 (from $6.59). FQ3'27: bookings $3.48bn (from $2.70bn), adj. EPS $3.43 (from $3.11).
FY28 and FY29 estimates rose: FY28 bookings $8.70bn (+2%), adj. EPS $8.70 (from $8.38). FY29 bookings $9.42bn, adj. EPS $10.91 (from $10.52).

market_movers.rationale: GS reiterates Buy and raises the PT from $285 to $290 on updated operating estimates and management commentary. The PT blends 33.0x EV/GAAP EBITDA on NTM+1 estimates with a DCF at 35.0x EV/FCF-SBC.

earnings_insights: FQ2'27 (reported 11/9-11/10): net bookings $1,601mm vs GS $1,654mm and consensus $1,702mm, against guidance of $1,620-1,670mm.
FQ2'27 net revenues $1,497mm vs GS $1,456mm and consensus $1,460mm, against guidance of $1,420-1,470mm.
FQ2'27 non-GAAP EPS $0.99 vs GS $0.97 and consensus $0.97, against guidance of $0.90-1.00. Non-GAAP EBIT was $230mm vs GS $236mm and consensus $238mm.
FQ2'27 non-GAAP gross margin was 69.1% vs consensus 58.7%. Non-GAAP EBIT margin was 14.3% vs consensus 12.3%.
GS estimates FQ3'27 (est): net revenues $3,402mm (from $2,608mm), bookings $3,482mm, adj. EBIT $801mm and adj. EPS $3.43.
GS estimates FY27 (est): adj. EPS $6.00 (from $6.59), adj. EBIT $1,411mm (from $1,563mm), net revenues $8,175mm.
GS estimates FY28 (est) adj. EPS $8.70 and FY29 (est) adj. EPS $10.91.
risk_factors: Engagement and user growth: lower units and live services sales for GTA, Red Dead Online and NBA 2K Online, weaker receptivity to new games, or slower growth in mobile.
Integration: slower integration of acquisitions such as Zynga, game release delays or core franchise decay could raise development costs.
Regulation: potential loss of key IP licensing agreements and tighter regulation of loot boxes and microtransactions.
Competition: more competition in console and mobile as development tools commoditize, and possible consolidation among competitors.
Macro: consumer spending weakness and exposure to investor risk appetite for growth stocks.

tension_points.bull_case: GS says GTA VI pre-orders are tracking well above initial expectations, and the unchanged FY27 outlook implies management confidence in demand.
tension_points.bear_case: Management kept FY27 guidance despite stronger pre-orders and is waiting for post-launch data. NBA 2K27 and mobile weakness drove RCS down 9% YoY and bookings below estimates.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Weak GTA VI launch-unit performance or Ultimate Edition mix after the November 19 release, or no 2H27 acceleration in NBA 2K bookings.
